acceptance_criteria: With SpecSync configured and no native change recorded, chough checkpoint --no-native-change <reason> records the reason in the session; its gated stage moves are then allowed and labelled ungated:no-native-change-required, so it reaches done and is archived with outcome done, the story keeping the reason; an open human gate still refuses the move; a blank reason is refused; the flag is refused while a native change is recorded, and recording one removes the reason.

answers.constraints: The specs/cli/cli.3md lesson on native tasks applies: human gates are plain text in tasks.md, not checkboxes, and the deltas are frozen at approval. REQ-cli-030 is unchanged: no flag or reason bypasses a human gate, and this flag does not.
